Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Southwestern Polypropylene Area Rug, 5' 3" x 7' 7", Multi
Materials: Polypropylene
Embolden your home decor with this striking Southwest-inspired rug. With an orange-and-blue color focus, this rug presents an engaging design that will add energy to any room and perfectly complete your home’s Southwest-style ambiance. 5'3" x 7'7" Polypropylene Frisee Machine made 0.33 Med
